description: Reduce repeated Budget calculations and skip work for empty periods in the performance test copy.
scope: Test copy only. Original financial plan, Apps Script, other sheet formulas, and named ranges are unchanged.
status: Applied and verified on 2026-11-20. Original BUDGET_TIMELINE_LINK definition restored after both link experiments.
changesSummary: Reuse identical LET bindings and existing BUDGET_VALUE results.
Return zero before calculating empty periods and future-year past setup expenses.
Return the existing blank-budget status before calculating unused status inputs.

formulaChanges.before:
=LET(
  past_payments, BUDGET_VALUE("past expenses"),
  planned_budget, BUDGET_VALUE("required budget"),
  available_budget, BUDGET_VALUE("available budget"),
  IFS(
    available_budget = "", "N\A", 
    past_payments > available_budget, "Over Budget",
    planned_budget > available_budget, "Projected Over Budget",
    available_budget = 0, "No Budget",
    TRUE, "Within Budget"
))

=IF(
  month_count = 0,
  0,
  LET(
    keys, COL_VALUES(source_table, lookup_col),
    first_row, ROW(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) + MATCH(lookup_value, keys, 0),

    first_col, COLUMN(INDEX(source_table, 1, 1)) - 1 + MATCH(start_month, INDEX(source_table, 1, 0), 0),

      amount
    )
  )
)

performance.conclusion: First-pass observations improved from 25.840/28.941 seconds to 20.981/25.339 seconds. This is a modest observed improvement, with insufficient repeats to separate it reliably from run-to-run variation. Disabling links did not materially improve on the first pass. Progress bars remain.
